title: Michigan-first cross-system building-failure differential prompts
notice: Examples support question selection, not causation proof; real conditions and new failure modes exceed the list.

systems.possible_mechanism: Negative surface grading or blocked runoff path
systems.alternative_explanation: Overflow from roof drainage or seasonal high groundwater
systems.discriminating_verification: Observe drainage during precipitation; measure surface slope; trace roof discharge
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Concentrated water reaching foundation or pedestrian ice hazard
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Crack or displacement on accessible foundation face
systems.discriminating_verification: Measure crack width and displacement; inspect drainage, history and structural load path; refer if movement suspected
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Significant displacement, instability or active water entry
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Uneven, sagging or moisture-marked floor surface
systems.alternative_explanation: Span, load, foundation settlement or earlier repairs
systems.discriminating_verification: Inspect accessible underside, member condition, moisture readings and load paths
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Unsupported or visibly failing floor platform
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Visible bowed or altered member at accessible framing
systems.alternative_explanation: Nonstructural irregularity, prior modification or moisture damage
systems.discriminating_verification: Confirm member size, span, connections, loading and alteration record with qualified professional
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Cracked load-bearing member or visibly compromised connection
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Staining, cracking or separation near cladding and openings
systems.alternative_explanation: Surface condensation or non-active legacy staining
systems.discriminating_verification: Trace flashing and drainage-plane details where safely visible; moisture meter and targeted noninvasive evaluation
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Loose facade components or ongoing water entry
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Staining, damaged covering or ponding on visible roof area
systems.possible_mechanism: Age-related material distress or poor water shedding
systems.alternative_explanation: Storm damage, condensation or debris blockage
systems.discriminating_verification: Document drainage/flashings from safe vantage; review leak history and attic underside where accessible
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Active leakage or apparent collapse risk; avoid unsafe roof access
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Discoloration, dampness or condensation on accessible attic material
systems.alternative_explanation: Roof covering leak, plumbing vent leakage or past inactive damage
systems.discriminating_verification: Measure moisture and humidity, observe vent terminations, compare weather history
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Electrical hazard near wet materials or visibly unstable roof framing
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Localized wall, ceiling or flooring stain/crack
systems.alternative_explanation: Plumbing source, condensation or historic repaired event
systems.discriminating_verification: Review adjacent rooms/above/below, moisture readings and leak history
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Active water near electrical, failing stairs or unsafe guarding
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Exposed conductor, heat marks or panel corrosion where visible
systems.possible_mechanism: Damaged wiring, loose termination or water exposure
systems.alternative_explanation: Surface dirt, labeling issue or pre-existing non-active staining
systems.discriminating_verification: Qualified electrician to inspect de-energized condition and test as appropriate; do not open energized components
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Arcing, hot equipment, damaged insulation or exposed live parts
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Moisture and corrosion near accessible joint
systems.discriminating_verification: Observe under operating conditions when safe, meter moisture, trace water source
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Active uncontrolled leak or contaminated wastewater
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Rust, water trace or soot around water heater
systems.discriminating_verification: Verify exact product/venting instructions and operating checks by qualified technician
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Potential combustion-gas hazard, apparent unsafe venting or active leak
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Corrosion, water pooling or irregular vent termination
systems.alternative_explanation: Normal defrost drainage, inactive history or adjacent plumbing
systems.discriminating_verification: Review model-specific manufacturer instructions; qualified HVAC operational testing
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Suspected combustion exhaust exposure or damaged gas piping
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.

systems.symptom_to_check: Wet soil, stained members or displaced supports
systems.possible_mechanism: Ground moisture intrusion or poor vapor control
systems.alternative_explanation: Plumbing leak, surface runoff or seasonal flood history
systems.discriminating_verification: Moisture mapping, observe source routes, assess support geometry and access limitations
systems.urgent_escalation_cue: Visible structural instability, active flooding or suspected biological hazard
systems.expertise_boundary: A visual clue is not a diagnosis. Risk/urgency requires judgment; obtain professional testing or safe access as appropriate.
